snippet_primary: "If the retail price of a Product is listed in a currency other than United States Dollars (USD), Gumroad will calculate a USD price based upon an exchange rate determined by Gumroad. Gumroad uses exchange rates obtained from http://openexchangerates.org/api. Gumroad cannot and does not guarantee that the exchange rate displayed reflects the most up to date rate due to the fluctuating nature of exchange rates. Accordingly, Gumroad recommends that you confirm current rates before engaging in any transactions on the Platform. Regardless of listed currency, all transactions through the Services will settle in USD."
subject_exact: Cláusula de conversión de moneda: precio USD calculado con tasa determinada por Gumroad usando openexchangerates.org, sin garantía de que la tasa mostrada sea la más actualizada; todas las transacciones se liquidan en USD
local_qualifiers: Gumroad recommends that you confirm current rates
parser_notes: Normalización anclada a la Effective Date (January 1, 2025).
